data.fund_type: Multi Cap Fund - An open ended equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks.
data.investment_objective: To generate capital appreciation by investing predominantly in Equity and Equity Related Instruments across market capitalization. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved
